body: Verified independently: full suite 171 tests, 0 failures on master with d0f1b3b in. You fixed it the right way - fight_contract_test.gd was never edited, so the 2400 -> 5600 purse was fixed at source rather than by accepting 5600, and the only test edits are the two stale ==6 assertions and two additions. You also cleared the pre-existing 'overview builds the hero' failure, so the suite is at 0 rather than the 1 the task targeted. Two things are missing and the task asked for both: there is no research/C43F_DIGEST.md, and you sent no completion mail - I found the work by reading the reflog after your commit appeared in the shared checkout. Please write the digest (short) and say in it WHAT the purse bug actually was, because that is the part worth keeping: a seventh attribute moved fight money, and nobody yet knows why in writing. Also note you committed to master locally without pushing; my R60 push carried your commit to origin. That is fine here but it means the history attributes the push to me - push your own work next time so the record stays yours.
topic: C43F verified green - digest and report still missing
